plugins.name: ace
plugins.description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search. v6.6.4: Bugfix — subagent learning now actually reaches the server. ace_stop_wrapper.sh runs after_task ASYNC in the background so its `ace-cli learn` SSE stream survives past the hook return, but ace_subagent_stop_wrapper.sh ran after_task SYNCHRONOUSLY — bound by the SubagentStop hook timeout, so Claude Code killed ace-cli MID-STREAM before it reached the server. Evidence: of 87 after_tasks that reached the read step, only 3 ever completed the learn (all main/Stop); ZERO subagents. Fix: add the same ACE_ASYNC_LEARNING background block to ace_subagent_stop_wrapper.sh (write input to a temp file, launch python3 ace_after_task.py detached, drop an in-flight lock, return immediately). Subagent ExecutionTraces now reach the server → subagent reward/bandit warming finally works end-to-end (completes the v6.6.0/6.6.2/6.6.3 chain). Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.139, ace-cli >= 3.17.0 (@ace-sdk/core >= 2.19.0).
